run_gen_image: run gen_image.py to generate an image from a text prompt using the HuggingFace Flux pipeline
run_gen_image_with_seed: run gen_image.py with a custom seed to produce reproducible image generation results
run_gen_image_with_steps: run gen_image.py specifying the number of inference steps for image quality control
run_gen_image_save_output: run gen_image.py to generate an image and save it to a specified output file path
run_gen_image_cli: run gen_image.py as a CLI tool with argparse flags for prompt, seed, steps, and output file
